facts.text: Fort Hays State hosts the Kansas Academy of Mathematics and Science, an early college STEM program offering tuition-free college credits to 11th and 12th grade public school students.

sources.title: Kansas Academy of Math & Science | Early College FHSU
sources.quote: KAMS is Kansas' premier early college program designed to provide a STEM-focused academic experience for gifted & talented 11th & 12th grade students.

sources.title: Kansas Academy of Math & Science | Early College FHSU
sources.quote: KAMS provides tuition free college credits for those attending a Kansas public high school.
